name: @negentropy/dsh-browser-flow
description: Observe and operate the user's already-open, already-authenticated DeepSeek Harness Desktop Sidebar Browser page

scripts.build: node --import tsx/esm scripts/build-host.ts && node --import tsx/esm scripts/build-client.ts && node --import tsx/esm scripts/build-graph.ts
scripts.test: node --import tsx/esm scripts/build-client.ts && node --import tsx/esm scripts/build-graph.ts --test-helper && node --import tsx/esm --test "tests/*.test.{js,ts}"
scripts.test:coverage: node --import tsx/esm scripts/build-client.ts && node --import tsx/esm scripts/build-graph.ts --test-helper && node --import tsx/esm --test --experimental-test-coverage "tests/*.test.{js,ts}"
scripts.verify: npm run build && node --import tsx/esm scripts/build-graph.ts --test-helper && go -C native/graph-core test ./... && npm run typecheck && node --import tsx/esm --test "tests/*.test.{js,ts}"
